description: Tests + UI wiring: write the 24-scenario structural test suite for the migration and adapter changes; wire DocumentSearchResults into the Quotation list and Invoice list pages. Depends on FEAT-001 (migration file must exist for tests to read) and FEAT-002 (component must exist for UI wiring).
steps: Read src/tests/critical/itemLibraryForwardIngestionMigration.test.js in full to confirm the exact test scaffolding pattern (loadMigration helper, readdirSync, glob filter, assert.match with regex).
Read src/components/quotation/QuotationList.tsx in full to understand its current structure before editing it.

Create src/tests/critical/documentSearchPlatform.test.js using node:test + node:assert/strict. Load the migration by filtering readdirSync(migrationsDir) for files matching '*document_search_platform*'. Load moduleAdapters.ts source text for structural assertions. Implement all 24 test cases listed in plan.md:
  Tests 1-9: migration file structure (extension, index names, GIN keyword)
  Tests 10-16: search_documents RPC contract (no item_id in WHERE for item queries, client_id scoping, DISTINCT ON dedup, LIMIT, no SECURITY DEFINER, LANGUAGE sql STABLE)
  Tests 17-24: ranking values (1000 for exact number, 300 for item description substring), provisioning coverage (entity_* backfill DO block, tenant_master_template install, NOTIFY pgrst), adapter changes (quotation_title and invoice_title in SELECT and ILIKE filter).
  Note: test 24 must check NOTIFY pgrst 'reload schema' exists in the migration.

Edit src/components/quotation/QuotationList.tsx to wire useDocumentSearch. Import useDocumentSearch from @/hooks/useDocumentSearch and DocumentSearchResults from @/components/search/DocumentSearchResults and useNavigate from react-router-dom (if not already imported). Read the file first to locate where the search term state is sourced (it comes from useDocumentQuery). Pass that same search term to useDocumentSearch via setSearch. When useDocumentSearch.search.trim().length >= 2, render <DocumentSearchResults results={results} loading={loading} error={error} onNavigate={(r) => navigate(r.route)} /> instead of the normal list body. When search term < 2 chars, render the normal list.

Edit src/pages/Invoices.tsx to wire useDocumentSearch into InvoicesContent. Read the file first to find where state.search is used. Import useDocumentSearch and DocumentSearchResults. When state.search.trim().length >= 2 AND useDocumentSearch has results, show <DocumentSearchResults> overlay above the list (or replacing it — match whichever pattern is structurally cleaner in the existing component). Pass document_types: ['invoice'] to useDocumentSearch. Call navigate(r.route) on result click.
Run bun run audit:load to confirm no new load-risk patterns.
Run bun run test to confirm all tests pass including the new documentSearchPlatform.test.js.
Run bun run typecheck to confirm no type errors in any modified file.
Update FEAT-003 status to 'completed' and record test results in findings.
acceptance_criteria: src/tests/critical/documentSearchPlatform.test.js exists and all 24 tests pass under bun run test
bun run test exits 0 — existing tests are not broken
bun run typecheck exits 0 — no type errors in QuotationList.tsx or Invoices.tsx after wiring
QuotationList renders DocumentSearchResults when search term >= 2 chars
Invoices page renders DocumentSearchResults when search term >= 2 chars
Navigation from a search result calls navigate(result.route) correctly

DocumentSearchResults renders when search term >= 2 chars in both pages; navigation calls navigate(result.route).
